messages.subject: 為何決策樹跑不出來
messages.body_plain:
# Tree

set.seed(123)
fit_tree <- train(
  form = G3 ~ .,
  data = math_train,
  method = "rpart",
  trControl = trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10),
  tuneLength = 10
)
fit_tree
vip(fit_tree, num_features = 10)

require(rpart.plot)
prp(fit_tree,         # 模型
    faclen=0,           # 呈現的變數不要縮寫
    fallen.leaves=TRUE, # 讓樹枝以垂直方式呈現
    shadow.col="gray",  # 最下面的節點塗上陰影
    # number of correct classifications / number of observations in that node
    extra=2)

messages.subject: Re: 為何決策樹跑不出來
messages.body_plain:
Hi friend,

# 決策樹無法繪製 VIP 主要問題應該是 train {caret}:

fit_tree <- train(
  form = G3 ~ .,
  data = math_train,
  method = "rpart",
  trControl = trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10),
  tuneLength = 10
)

# 結果顯示以下警告
Warning message:
In nominalTrainWorkflow(x = x, y = y, wts = weights, info = trainInfo,  :
  There were missing values in resampled performance measures.

# 以下連結有說明其意義, 有興趣可以參考 https://github.com/topepo/caret/issues/1124
# This is almost always because some tuning parameter combination produced predictions that are constant for all samples. train() tries to compute the R^2 and, since it needs a non-zero variance, it produces an NA for that statistic.

# Analysis
# 將上述 train 程式碼, 改為 rpart 函數即可繪圖.

set.seed(123)
fit_treeNew <- rpart(G3 ~ ., data = math_train)
vip(fit_treeNew, num_features = 10)

prp(fit_treeNew,        # 模型

    faclen=0,           # 呈現的變數不要縮寫
    fallen.leaves=TRUE, # 讓樹枝以垂直方式呈現

    shadow.col="gray")

# end
